notes: The repo's validation step: PROC COMPARE BASE=... COMP=... LISTALL of an independently derived ADSL against the reference ADSL, with the author's TITLE/FOOTNOTE. BASE/COMP redirected to two small bundled ADSL tables that differ in two cells (AGE, BMI) so the comparison reports; ODS RTF/PRINTTO removed so the listing prints. This is the exact validation technique the repo is built around.
